notes: [S115-01] The opening reports that the points of S with values in script D form a category, and then supposes a codimension map c: D_* → N. The singular formé and the sentence’s singular est are transcribed as written; their grammar has not been repaired. This is a report of the manuscript assertion, not a proof check.

[S115-02] Formulas (271), (172), and (173) present the degree decomposition and the inverse-image pieces for the source/target map. The pairs of indices and the target product were compared throughout this page for type and index consistency, and each occurrence was rechecked on the ink. This is a visual/notation consistency check, not a proof of the categorical construction.

[S115-03] The upper margin claims that the codimension function comes from the other structures. The lower margin says that b) will follow from c), followed by a doubtful parenthetical phrase favoring thm prouvé?. Neither claim has been proved in this reading; c) is unfinished on the assigned sheet.

[S115-04] In (174a), phi is used where the text states that D_{d,d'} is empty for d' > d. The long projecting stem determines the transcribed graphic form. The meaning is read from this local formula; no outside-page convention was used to replace the observed glyph.

[S115-05] Condition (174b) asks for the identity morphism to induce isomorphisms D_d ≃ D_{d,d}. Its explanatory arrow and its equals sign standing for same are copied literally. No implication has been independently established from the omitted continuation of c).

[S115-06] The number (271) is retained from its curved first digit. The surrounding sequence makes a numbering slip plausible, but does not license changing it to 171. The small down-right pointer and the undulating stroke adjacent to (174) are reproduced graphically without assigning an unobserved referent.

[S115-07] The quoted word source stands above the canceled formula in c) and remains live. It attaches as a qualifier after le morphisme. No visible insertion leader fixes a separate writing chronology, so the linear transcription preserves that attachment without claiming a distinct insertion stage.

[S115-08] Three canceled spans were checked independently: the opening short group, induit after the identity map, and the final formula. The raised source qualifier is outside the final cancellation. The lower operator group is spatially beneath the source term and is retained there, with local uncertainty.

[S115-09] The sheet is upright. line_count counts 21 main writing baselines, including displayed-formula rows; the two diagonal marginal notes, label pointer and pencil archive number are inventoried separately. H’s editorial note about continuation is not source text. Only scan 115 was used.
